rows.label: יליד
rows.value: ברוקלין, ניו יורק · בן ניצולי שואה
rows.value_en: Brooklyn, New York · son of Holocaust survivors
rows.source_quote: The inventor of the pad, Bernard Bar-Natan, is a self-described Brooklyn boy, a son of Holocaust survivors

rows.label: עלה לישראל
rows.source_quote: immigrated to Israel in 1979 and was drafted into the military in 1983, serving an abbreviated service as an adult

rows.label: שירות בצה"ל
rows.value: גויס 1983 · חיל חובשים · שירות מקוצר לעולה מבוגר
rows.value_en: Drafted 1983 · Medical Corps · abbreviated service for older immigrants
rows.source_quote: drafted into the military in 1983, serving an abbreviated service as an adult

rows.label: שנת ההמצאה
rows.source_quote: Since its 1993 invention, the Israeli bandage has become standard issue in militaries throughout the world.

rows.label: פטנט
rows.value: US5628723A · הוגש 14.2.1996 · פורסם 13.5.1997 · רשום על שם "Bernard Grau" (שם הלידה; זיהוי עקיף)
rows.value_en: US5628723A · filed 14 Feb 1996 · published 13 May 1997 · listed under "Bernard Grau" (birth name; identification is circumstantial)
rows.source_quote: Inventor: Bernard Grau · Current Assignee: FIRST CARE PRODUCTS LTD · Publication Date: May 13, 1997

rows.label: החברה
rows.value: First Care Products Ltd. · הוקמה 1995 · מטה בלוד
rows.value_en: First Care Products Ltd. · founded 1995 · headquartered in Lod
rows.source_quote: First Care Products Ltd. · Headquarters: Lod, Israel · Founded: 1995

rows.label: ייצור
rows.value: מפעל אחמד חייב, טובא-זנגריה, גליל · כ-50 עובדות · מיליוני יחידות בשנה
rows.value_en: Ahmed Heib's factory, Tuba-Zangariyya, Galilee · ~50 workers (all women) · millions of units per year
rows.source_quote: He expanded his factory to three floors capable of producing millions of bandages a year. All 50 of his employees are women.

rows.label: תקינה בצבא ארה"ב
rows.value_en: 2003 (after adoption by the 75th Rangers and 101st Airborne, 2000–2001)
rows.source_quote: Soon his company, First Care, was selling the bandage for use by elite units, including the 75th Rangers and the 101st Airborne. Three years later the bandage was certified for standard use.

rows.label: בעלות
rows.value: 2012: PerSys Medical רכשה רוב מניות ב-First Care Products · 2021: Safeguard Medical רכשה את PerSys
rows.value_en: 2012: PerSys Medical acquired majority stake in First Care Products · 2021: Safeguard Medical acquired PerSys
rows.source_quote: In 2012, the American company PerSys Medical purchased a majority share in First Care Products. Nine years later, in 2021, PerSys Medical was acquired by Safeguard Medical.
